judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and type definitions (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the issue's specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, and `ConversationSummary`. It completely omitted the opt-in configuration flag `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` (leaving the feature always enabled) and the new `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it directly violated the explicit requirement to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error when `listFor` is unimplemented, returning an empty list `sessions: []` instead. Validation bounds on `limit` (1–200) were also missed (allowing 0 and >200), and `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` were not updated.
